title: Start code for a program
statement: Given a light program $P$ and a Boolean flag $d$, the start code consists of the straight-line initialization code, determined by the frame size and dispatcher position, followed by a conditional jump to the main-code position when the designated register is negative.
caveat: The definitions of the initialization code, dispatcher position, and designated register are not supplied, so their exact mathematical meanings are unavailable.
